_doc: UPDATE 12 section 2 (DECISIONS T-208): the material pass's rules, docs/ART_BIBLE.md section 7. gravelight/world/look/look_materials.gd applies them to every world material on a map when it loads (LookGrade.attach) and tools/look/material_audit lists what breaks them before and after. `tex_tint` / `tex_rough` are written by the audit (--write-fixes): an albedo texture whose average fights the palette gets a desaturating multiply on the materials that use it, a roughness texture that averages under the floor gets its scalar raised. Skips: characters and viewmodels (their own shaders and skin rules), section 5's C-47 wreck (its own art pass), the cartoon worlds (Bolt & Sprocket, The Fine Print stay cartoon), and the bible's low-roughness list (glass, ice, water, Nachtglas). Presentation only.
